messages:
asha: Quick heads-up — Greenline QBR scheduled Tue 10AM PT. Need a 30m pre-QBR cost triage today focused on token economics (embeddings-heavy), spend forecast for next quarter, and any enablement blockers. Who can join 30m standup today? cc @dylan @priya

dylan: I can do 3pm PT. Do we have the latest 30/60/90 day usage exports? Last forecast I saw had embeddings at ~1.2M vectors/mo.

priya: I’ll pull the onboarding playbook + enablement notes. There was an open action on batch inference they wanted to enable — that will change token counts and egress. Linking the doc in a sec.

priya: https://redwood.internal/greenline/batch-infer — key: they switched to 512-d embeddings last week, so cost per vector changed.

sanjay_fin: FYI billing flag triggered last week (invoice B-7890). Quick numbers: current run rate ~$8.7k/mo; embeddings ~68% of usage. If product ships the new feature and usage doubles, forecast ~ $17-18k/mo. Recommend reserve or throttle options.

milo_support: From enablement side: their integration hasn't finished hooks for caching callbacks, so we're seeing repeated prefix calls. I can demo the cache snippet in the pre-QBR and follow up with code.

asha: Agenda for the 30m: 1) run-rate + 2 scenario forecasts (x1.2, x2) 2) immediate cost levers (batching, KV caching, quantization) 3) enablement asks + owners. Sound OK?

dylan: Sounds good. I'll bring a per-route token breakdown and a tiny script to estimate 90-day spend: `python scripts/forecast.py --account greenline --days 90`

priya: I'll own the enablement demo and follow-up checklist. Action: send pre-QBR snapshot to Greenline PM and include suggested throttles.

sanjay_fin: Quick options summary I'll prep: 1) Dedicated burst/reserved capacity for peak jobs 2) account-level cost guardrail quotas 3) trade-off doc for commit vs on-demand (discount math). Draft numbers by EOD.

ops-bot: Billing alert: Greenline usage increased by 85% over baseline yesterday — triggered rule embed_spike_high. Details: https://redwood.ops/alerts/12345

asha: OK locking 3pm PT standup. Milo please paste the caching snippet here. Dylan/Sanjay — post the quick forecast table before the meeting. I'll invite Greenline PM to the QBR and share the pre-read. :thumbsup:

milo_support: caching snippet (pseudo):
```
# reuse prefix KV cache to avoid re-embedding
if prefix in kv_cache:
  reuse_kv(prefix)
else:
  embeddings_api.call(prefix)
```
Full playbook will be attached after the meeting.

dylan: Quick forecast (rough):
- current run rate: $8.7k/mo
- growth x1.2 -> $10.4k/mo
- growth x2 -> $17.4k/mo
Notes: embeddings estimate assumes avg request = 2 vectors @512-d. Will post csv with per-route breakdown.

sanjay_fin: I'll create the reserve vs throttle options doc at /shared/finance/greenline-cost-options and tag the CSMs. ETA EOD.

asha: Thanks everyone. Calendar invite for 3pm PT sent. If you can't make, drop notes in this thread and tag owners. End.
